raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) was delivered twice, at 02:00 and 05:00 ingest_ts, so it has 652 rows, exactly twice its 326 unique transactions. The extra rows are byte-identical duplicates, which doubled the 2026-01-18 POSTED rows in silver (316 txn_ids x 2 = 632) and inflated every gold table. Deduplicating raw_transactions on txn_id, keeping the latest ingest, before the POSTED filter restores correct silver and gold data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
